searchText: What happen if a validator create a lot of transaction in each blocks and sent it to heself how a private transaction? Is it a possibles gas ddos or not? Why would that be a ddos? As long abide by the rules of the protocol (i.e. you pay for used gas), you can do whatever you want in the blocks you build. If it can cause a high gas fees coul turn the network less attractive to users But why is this limited to your own blocks? You can just spam the network with transactions now, and pump up the gas price it'll cost you though, so you can't keep it up for long I dont do tests with private transactions If the gas spent is to validator i believe that it is valid vector atack I think you're misunderstanding the rules of transaction inclusion. Ever since EIP-1559, you can't include your own transactions for free [0]. You _have_ to pay the base fee (which is burned). [0] Note that including your own transactions was never really "free" even before EIP-1559, because it came at the cost of _not_ including some other transaction that paid you. excerpts.content:
I think you're misunderstanding the rules of transaction inclusion. Ever since EIP-1559, you can't include your own transactions for free [0]. You _have_ to pay the base fee (which is burned). 

[0] Note that including your own transactions was never really "free" even before EIP-1559, because it came at the cost of _not_ including some other transaction that paid you.
